Definition
[Dini derivatives] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0051 1. ch10:10.22\group Dini derivative tools

For a function $f$, define $d^+f/dt$, $d^-f/dt$, $d_+f/dt$, and $d_-f/dt$ as the limsup/liminf of forward/backward difference quotients.
